verdict.rationale: Factory's docs say "a designer shares a mockup, and the system implements it," but that line appears in the agent-readiness overview as a description of the end-state vision, not as a documented attachment feature. Design mode, where you select an element, say what to change, and Droid acts in place, gives a related route to visual changes. Neither item shows that you can actually attach a marked-up screenshot or mockup image to a task. Missing for 10: documented image/screenshot attachment in App, CLI, or Linear/Jira tasks; support for annotated or marked-up images; concrete workflow docs; hands-on or independent corroboration.
